lines.text: Section 5.05 In the event that any work by Developer, in connection with
construction of Developer's New Building (“Developer's Construction Work") shall
result in the placing of a violation upon the Townhouse Property, Developer shall, at
Developer's cost and expense, be solely responsible for curing same and shall promptly
take all steps to cure such violations of record. In the event that said violations have not
been discharged or record within thirty (30) days, or any shorter period of time required
by law or the terms of any mortgage on the Townhouse Property after receiving notice of
same from Owner, Owner may, upon the giving of ten (10) days' prior written notice to
Developer, proceed to cure such violations at Developer's expense.
Section 5.06 If Owner is compelled or elects to expend any sum of money or do
any acts which require the payment of money by reason of complying with, remedying or
curing a violation on the Townhouse Property that is caused by Developer's Construction
Work, Developer shall, upon demand, promptly reimburse Owner all such sums such
expenditure. Such expenses shall be limited to reasonable and customary third-party
expenses which are necessary to cure such violations.
